title: Clinical Co-Pilot — Consolidated Audit Summary (AUDIT_V2.md)
scope_summary: This document consolidates audit findings, RBAC user-role constraints, and architecture decisions for the Clinical Co-Pilot effort. It summarizes resolved and open risks, especially around RBAC enforcement, FHIR data tagging, latency validation, and source-document drift. It also traces PRD features to architectural anchors and task PRs to keep implementation aligned with audit outcomes.
key_decisions_or_requirements: RBAC must be enforced at the agent retrieve layer, not only in the UI.
NURSE role remains a read-only subset and must be blocked from labs, visit notes, and problem list.
Refusals must explicitly name role and tool, log policy-safe metadata, and avoid side-channel leakage.
Agent design requires single-patient session scoping with reset on patient navigation changes.
Verification must be programmatic (grounding plus domain rules), not LLM-as-judge.
Critical open items include Observation category-tagging correctness, pre-visit summary latency proof, and Word/markdown source drift reconciliation.
